verdict.rationale: Lithic publishes a hosted API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g. /reference/postcards). Its docs also say an AI assistant can 'inspect endpoint schemas' and 'execute live API requests' from the editor, which gives an AI-native user a way to explore and run calls. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive with try-it or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of in-browser try-it/runnable examples in the reference, code samples per endpoint, a public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
